name: poly_sophie_germain_not_irreducible
statement: (a : ℤ) : ¬ Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 4 + Polynomial.C (4 * a ^ 4) : Polynomial ℤ)
closed: ∀ (a : ℤ), ¬ Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 4 + Polynomial.C (4 * a ^ 4) : Polynomial ℤ)
informal: Sophie Germain: X^4 + 4a^4 is reducible over ℤ for every integer a — X^4 + 4a^4 = (X^2 + 2aX + 2a^2)(X^2 - 2aX + 2a^2), both monic of degree 2 hence non-units.
